description: Surface the real permissions (Problem 3, UI layer) end-to-end and add onboarding prompts. Extend the Settings Permissions section to show Microphone, Contacts, Location, and Accessibility with real states and per-item request/enable buttons, and add Location + Accessibility onboarding slides alongside the existing Mic/Contacts slides. Wire app.js handlers to the native permission flow built in FEAT-003, using the generalized Storage.setPermission/getPermission from FEAT-001. Add the needed Iconsax symbols. Then run the final cross-consistency + static verification pass for the whole task. Depends on FEAT-001 (storage) and FEAT-003 (native bridge methods).
steps: index.html inline SVG sprite (in <head>): add a <symbol id="isax-location" ...> and a <symbol id="isax-security-safe"> (or isax-shield) using the same viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" style as existing symbols, for the Location and Accessibility rows. Use simple valid Iconsax-style paths. These are needed because no location/accessibility icon exists yet.

index.html Settings Permissions section: add two new .permission-item rows after Contacts: Location (icon isax-location, status span id="perm-location") and Accessibility (icon isax-security-safe/shield, status span id="perm-accessibility"). Give each of the four rows an action button in Mayra's warm Hinglish: Microphone/Contacts/Location each get an 'Allow' button calling a per-item request handler (e.g. App.requestPermissionFromSettings('microphone'|'contacts'|'location')); Accessibility gets an 'Enable' button calling App.openAccessibilitySettings(). Keep the existing 'System settings mein jaao' button.

index.html onboarding: add a Location slide (data-slide="location", icon isax-location) with an 'Allow location' primary button calling App.requestLocationPermission() and an 'Abhi nahi' ghost button calling App.onboardNext(); and an Accessibility slide (data-slide="accessibility", icon isax-security-safe/shield) explaining warmly why accessibility helps Mayra, with an 'Enable' button calling App.openAccessibilitySettings() and an 'Abhi nahi' button calling App.onboardNext(). Insert both BEFORE the 'done' slide.
js/app.js: update ONBOARD_SLIDES array to include the new slides in order: ['welcome','apikey','mic','contacts','location','accessibility','done'] so dots + navigation stay correct.

js/app.js: add requestLocationPermission() (mirror requestMicPermission/requestContactsPermission: await AndroidBridge.requestPermission('location'); Storage.setPermission('location', granted?'granted':'denied'); warm toast; onboardNext()). Add requestPermissionFromSettings(name) used by the Settings per-item Allow buttons: await AndroidBridge.requestPermission(name), persist via Storage.setPermission(mapNameToStorageKey), warm toast, then _updatePermissionStatus(). Map the JS bridge name 'microphone' to the storage key 'mic' (Storage uses 'mic'); 'contacts'/'location' map directly.

js/app.js: add openAccessibilitySettings() that calls AndroidBridge.openAccessibilitySettings() and shows a warm toast telling the user to toggle Mayra on in the Accessibility list; after returning, it may call _updatePermissionStatus().

js/app.js _updatePermissionStatus(): extend to update all four rows. For microphone: prefer real AndroidBridge.checkPermission('microphone'); for contacts/location: use AndroidBridge.checkPermission (native) falling back to Storage.getPermission; for accessibility: use AndroidBridge.isAccessibilityEnabled() -> map true->'granted' else Storage.getPermission('accessibility') (default 'unknown'), set the perm-accessibility span. Reuse _permLabel/_permClass helpers (they already handle granted/denied/unknown).

js/app.js public export: add requestLocationPermission, requestPermissionFromSettings, openAccessibilitySettings to the returned object so the new index.html onclick handlers resolve. (Confirm requestMicPermission/requestContactsPermission are already exported — they are.)

css/styles.css: if the new per-item Allow/Enable buttons need styling, add minimal rules reusing existing tokens/classes (e.g. reuse .btn-ghost.small or add a small .perm-action button style). Keep the existing .permission-item / .perm-status / .granted/.denied/.unknown styling working for the two new rows.

FINAL CROSS-CONSISTENCY PASS (whole task): (a) grep every App.<method> and AndroidBridge.<method> referenced in index.html onclick/onchange and confirm each is present in the corresponding module's returned public API object. (b) confirm JS permission names match Kotlin aliases; confirm openAccessibilitySettings/isAccessibilityEnabled names + result keys match. (c) confirm sw.js never-cache bypass includes generativelanguage.googleapis.com + api.groq.com + api.openai.com. (d) confirm no NEW top-level web file was added without also updating scripts/copy-web.js ITEMS (js/ subdir files are covered by the existing 'js' entry; only NEW root-level files need adding). (e) run `node scripts/copy-web.js` to confirm assets copy cleanly.

FINAL STATIC VERIFICATION: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check` on ALL changed .js files (js/storage.js, js/app.js, js/android-bridge.js, js/gemini-chat.js, and any new js file); validate AndroidManifest.xml and any new res/xml files as well-formed XML; sanity-check index.html for balanced tags around the edited sections (e.g. count new <symbol>/<section>/<div> open/close).
acceptance_criteria: `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check` passes for all changed JS files.

Settings Permissions section shows four rows (Microphone, Contacts, Location, Accessibility) with status spans perm-mic/perm-contacts/perm-location/perm-accessibility and per-item Allow/Enable buttons; onboarding includes Location and Accessibility slides before 'done'.

_updatePermissionStatus updates all four rows using real native state where available (checkPermission / isAccessibilityEnabled) with Storage fallback.
New isax-location and isax-security-safe/shield <symbol>s exist in the inline sprite and are referenced by the new rows/slides.
sw.js never-cache bypass includes generativelanguage.googleapis.com, api.groq.com, api.openai.com; no new root-level web file is missing from copy-web.js ITEMS.
AndroidManifest.xml and any new XML remain well-formed.

grep -oE 'App\.[a-zA-Z]+|AndroidBridge\.[a-zA-Z]+' index.html | sort -u, then confirm each exists in the App/AndroidBridge return objects
grep for perm-location, perm-accessibility, isax-location, isax-security-safe (or isax-shield) in index.html and confirm presence

findings: Implemented additively and verified statically (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, no builds). index.html: added <symbol id="isax-location"> and <symbol id="isax-security-safe"> to the inline sprite (both viewBox 0 0 24 24, stroke=currentColor, stroke-width=1.6, matching existing style); added Location + Accessibility rows to the Settings Permissions section (status spans perm-location / perm-accessibility) plus per-item action buttons on all four rows (mic/contacts/location -> App.requestPermissionFromSettings('microphone'|'contacts'|'location') 'Allow karo'; accessibility -> App.openAccessibilitySettings() 'Enable karo'); kept 'System settings mein jaao'. Added Location and Accessibility onboarding slides before 'done'. js/app.js: ONBOARD_SLIDES now ['welcome','apikey','mic','contacts','location','accessibility','done']; added requestLocationPermission(), requestPermissionFromSettings(name) (maps bridge 'microphone'->storage 'mic', else direct), openAccessibilitySettings(); extended _updatePermissionStatus() to all four rows (mic via checkPermission; contacts/location via checkPermission with Storage fallback when 'unknown'; accessibility via isAccessibilityEnabled() with Storage fallback); added the three new methods to the public export. css/styles.css: added .perm-actions (flex wrapper) and .perm-action button reusing existing tokens (--pink-500/--lavender-100/--white/--radius-full). VERIFICATION (all pass): `node --check` on js/app.js, js/storage.js, js/android-bridge.js, js/gemini-chat.js, sw.js. Every App.* referenced in index.html resolves to an exported function; no AndroidBridge.* is referenced directly from HTML. JS bridge permission names (microphone/contacts/location) match Kotlin @Permission aliases exactly; result keys match: requestPermission->{granted}, checkPermission->{status}, isAccessibilityEnabled->{enabled}, openAccessibilitySettings->{success}. sw.js never-cache bypass includes generativelanguage.googleapis.com + api.groq.com + api.openai.com. No new root-level web file added, so scripts/copy-web.js ITEMS unchanged; `node scripts/copy-web.js` copies cleanly with no warnings. AndroidManifest.xml parses as well-formed XML. index.html balanced: 17/17 <symbol>, 5/5 <section>, 88/88 <div>, 7 onboard-slides matching ONBOARD_SLIDES, 4 permission-item rows. USER NOTE re: new Gemini key prefix ('AQ.Ab8RN6JX' vs old 'AIza'): confirmed no code anywhere hardcodes an 'AIza' prefix or key-format/length check — validation is purely a live API ping in _testApiKey (FEAT-001), so new-format Gemini keys validate fine and network failures are never treated as invalid. No residual inconsistencies found.
